starting_class: Fresh fair-selector towers with arbitrary positive point-defect balancers Q_r and ranks r>=2.
new_class: Fresh fair-selector towers with arbitrary sign-flipped point-defect balancers -Q_r and ranks r>=2.
quantifiers: Every Boolean base P, every finite depth d, every rank sequence r_k>=2, and mutually disjoint physical blocks.
prior_bound: Positive-bias tower: G<=2^{-d}G(P)+24; negative near-constant bias unpaid.
new_bound: Negative-bias tower: G<=2^{-d}G(P)+34; U(P)<=(56/27)I(P) transfers with the same constant; H<=(166/27)I.
parameter_dependence: Independent of dimension, depth, ranks, biases -(1-2^{1-r}), and activation probabilities 2^{-r}.
universal_gap: Arbitrary sign mixtures, biased selectors, overlap, variable reuse, and changing coherent cores remain open.
next_action: Test and prove a finite-state age potential for alternating positive/negative signs.
